title: "Agent Environment"
page-type: contributor
audience: "Contributors using coding agents"
status: current
---

The repository provides a generated, project-local agent environment so coding agents follow the same domain language, repository boundaries, checks, and non-secret tool conventions as human contributors. Treat it as working infrastructure, not application implementation authority.

Use these canonical entry points rather than copying their inventories here:

- [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/ewheeler/aots/blob/main/AGENTS.md) defines repository-wide working rules, routing, safety boundaries, and required checks.
- [`.agents/`](https://github.com/ewheeler/aots/tree/main/.agents) contains the selected runtime profiles, tool guidance, prompts, privacy and safety settings, repository-map configuration, and vendored skills.
- [`.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml`](https://github.com/ewheeler/aots/blob/main/.repo-familiar/bootstrap.yml) records generator provenance, selected options, and checksums for generated assets.

Project-owned source, tests, `CONTEXT.md`, ADRs, and the [Repository Map](../agents/repository-map.md) remain authoritative for implemented behavior and semantic ownership. If generated agent configuration drifts, update it through its owning generator workflow rather than maintaining duplicated descriptions in documentation.

For documentation-specific ownership and checks, use the [Documentation Guide](documentation-guide.qmd).
